name: After recital CN
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: CNa. whereas the integrity, impartiality and political independence of the judiciary are essential to the proper functioning of democracy and to maintaining citizens’ trust in democratic institutions and the rule of law; whereas allegations of corruption, conflicts of interest, political interference or abuse of judicial power must therefore be subject to thorough, independent and transparent investigation; whereas the failure to ensure such scrutiny remains a serious deficiency even in countries regarded as established democracies and risks fostering impunity at the highest levels of the judiciary; whereas a particularly alarming example is the high-level corruption scandal currently engulfing Brazil’s Supreme Federal Court (STF), which has raised serious concerns over alleged corruption, conflicts of interest, politicisation and the weaponisation of judicial power; whereas these concerns are compounded by previous allegations concerning censorship, arbitrary detention and restrictions on freedom of expression, as well as by the sanctions imposed by the United States under the Global Magnitsky framework on STF Justice Alexandre de Moraes;
